blocks.text: Principal quantum number n musbat sahih qeematein 1, 2, 3, 4 waghaira le sakta hai, jinhen K, L, M, N kaha jata hai, aur yeh Bohr ke hydrogen atom model ke orbit number ke mutabiq hai. Yeh orbital ka size aur energy bayan karta hai. Ek hi n qeemat wale orbitals ka majmooa electron shell hai. n jitna bara, orbital mein electron ka nucleus se ausat fasla utna zyada aur is liye orbital utna bara; bara n yeh bhi matlab hai ke electron ki energy zyada hai aur woh nucleus se kam mazbooti se bandha hai. Principal quantum number formula 2n squared se shell mein electrons ki zyada se zyada tadaad bhi deta hai, to K, L, M aur N shells bil-tarteeb 2, 8, 18 aur 32 electrons rakh sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Ek electron ka n = 3 hai. n = 1 wale electron ke muqable us ke shell, nucleus se fasle aur pakar ke bare mein kya keh sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Woh M shell mein hai, jo 18 electrons tak rakh sakta hai. Ausatan woh n = 1 electron se nucleus se door hai, to us ka orbital bara, energy zyada aur bandhan kam mazboot hai.

items: n = 1, 2, 3, 4 (K, L, M, N): orbital ka size aur energy; bara n yani bara, zyada energy wala, kam mazbooti se bandha orbital. Shell zyada se zyada 2n squared electrons rakhta hai: 2, 8, 18, 32.
